SELECT
  eventTime,
  eventName,
  awsRegion,
  recipientAccountId,
  userIdentity.arn,
  userIdentity.type,
  userIdentity.accountId,
  userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.arn AS sessionIssuerArn,
  userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName AS sessionIssuerUserName,
  sourceIPAddress,
  userAgent,
  requestParameters,
  responseElements,
  errorCode,
  errorMessage
FROM cloudtrail_events
WHERE eventName = 'StopInstances'
  AND recipientAccountId = '702945318664'
  AND eventTime > '2026-09-25T17:00:00Z'
  AND eventTime < '2026-09-26T06:00:00Z'
ORDER BY eventTime ASC
